name: DayTrading
summary: DayTrading is an Expert Advisor designed for intraday scalping on lower timeframes. It enters trades based on momentum and short-term trend signals, targeting small price movements with tight take-profit levels. The EA aims to capture multiple small gains throughout the trading session while using stop-loss protection on each trade.
summary_zh: DayTrading是一个专为日内短线剥头皮设计的EA，在较低时间周期上运行。它根据动量和短期趋势信号入场，以较窄的止盈目标捕捉小幅价格波动。该EA试图在交易时段内通过多次小幅盈利累积收益，同时每笔交易都设有止损保护。
strategy_analysis: DayTrading EA采用日内剥头皮策略，专注于在低时间周期（如M5、M15）上捕捉短期价格波动。入场条件通常基于短期动量指标（如RSI、随机振荡器或MACD）的信号确认，结合价格行为判断短期趋势方向。出场条件包括固定点数的止盈和止损，止盈目标较小以适应剥头皮风格，止损设置相对紧凑以控制单笔亏损。仓位管理方面，EA可能采用固定手数或基于账户余额的动态手数计算方式。资金管理上，EA依赖每笔交易的止损来控制风险，但作为剥头皮策略，需要关注点差对盈利的影响，特别是在高波动时段点差扩大可能侵蚀利润。整体策略逻辑较为简单直接，适合流动性好的主流货币对。
strategy_analysis_en: The DayTrading EA employs an intraday scalping strategy focused on capturing short-term price movements on lower timeframes such as M5 or M15. Entry conditions are typically based on short-term momentum indicators like RSI, Stochastic oscillator, or MACD signals combined with price action to determine the immediate trend direction. Exit conditions include fixed-pip take-profit and stop-loss levels, with small take-profit targets suited to the scalping style and relatively tight stop-losses to limit individual trade losses. Position sizing may use fixed lot sizes or dynamic calculation based on account balance, though the exact method depends on the input parameters. Money management relies on per-trade stop-losses for risk control, but as a scalping strategy, spread costs are a critical factor since wide spreads during volatile periods can easily erode the thin profit margins. The overall strategy logic is straightforward and best suited for highly liquid major currency pairs.

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for identifying this EA's orders

pros: 策略逻辑简单清晰，易于理解和调整参数
每笔交易都有止损保护，单笔风险可控
日内交易不持仓过夜，避免隔夜风险和隔夜费
在趋势明确时段可以快速累积小幅盈利
适用于流动性好的主流货币对，点差较低时表现更佳
pros_en: Simple and clear strategy logic, easy to understand and adjust parameters
Every trade has stop-loss protection, limiting individual trade risk
No overnight positions, avoiding overnight risk and swap fees
Can accumulate small profits quickly during clear trend sessions
Performs best on liquid major pairs with low spreads
cons: 剥头皮策略对点差高度敏感，点差扩大时容易亏损
止盈目标较小，一次亏损可能抵消多次盈利
缺乏交易时段过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不利成交
频繁交易导致手续费成本累积较高
未见到明显的趋势过滤机制，可能在震荡市中频繁止损
cons_en: Scalping strategy is highly sensitive to spreads; widening spreads easily cause losses
Small take-profit targets mean one loss can wipe out multiple winning trades
Lacks session filter, may execute unfavorable trades during low-liquidity periods
Frequent trading leads to significant cumulative commission costs
No apparent trend filter mechanism, may suffer repeated stop-outs in ranging markets
improvements: 增加交易时段过滤功能，只在高低流动性和低点差时段交易
加入趋势过滤指标（如长期均线），避免在震荡市中频繁入场
增加点差检查机制，当点差超过阈值时暂停交易
考虑引入盈亏比动态调整机制，提高策略的适应性
improvements_en: Add trading session filter to trade only during high-liquidity and low-spread periods
Add trend filter indicator (e.g., long-term moving average) to avoid frequent entries in ranging markets
Add spread check mechanism to pause trading when spread exceeds threshold
Consider dynamic risk-reward ratio adjustment to improve strategy adaptability

risk_points: 剥头皮策略对点差极为敏感，点差扩大时风险显著增加
止盈小于止损的盈亏比意味着需要较高胜率才能盈利
缺乏交易时段和点差过滤可能在高成本时段产生亏损交易
频繁交易累积的手续费成本不可忽视
risk_points_en: Scalping strategy is extremely sensitive to spreads; risk increases significantly when spreads widen
Risk-reward ratio with TP smaller than SL requires high win rate to be profitable
Lack of session and spread filters may produce losing trades during high-cost periods
Cumulative commission costs from frequent trading cannot be ignored
